message:
In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), Retrofit Integration Architect and Structural Dynamics Lead, the bolted connection fatigue review has advanced but lacks formal closure. To check it I used review of the repeated check calculation (E10) with the static weight check (E11) and the midspan stress increment (E12). I found about 4373 Newtons peak per 400 kilogram module and about 2.5 Megapascals static plus 0.3 Megapascals dynamic per girder, according to Eurocode 3, 2005. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead confirms fatigue-non-critical status for Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) meaning mass-spring-damper absorber before joint proposal. My position: not ready because support safety sign-off is pending.

In the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) retrofit (C1), Vibration Control Specialist, the off-tune comfort and stroke mapping has incomplete robustness proof. To check it I used review of the detuned damping estimate (E8) against the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6) and the resonant response calculation (E1). I found 0.064 effective damping ratio at plus 5 percent detune without minus 5 percent to plus 5 percent acceleration and stroke values, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose Vibration Control Specialist adds off-tune acceleration in metres per second squared and stroke in millimetres for minus 5 percent to plus 5 percent. My position: not ready because blocking process check remains open.

Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: connection peak load quantified, awaiting fatigue sign-off.
Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: girder stress increment provided, formal closure needed.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: tuning closed at nominal, off-tune mapping still required.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: comfort target held, proposal on hold pending above.
